recommendations.architecture: one platform two modes — Mode A local CLI (WS1 evolved), Mode B SaaS (WS2 hardened); shared schema Program->Scope->Asset->Finding->Evidence->Report->Submission; shared 17-hunter library; human submission gate
recommendations.queue: Arq/RQ, saga job state machine persisted in own DB, retry backoff 30s->4min cap aligned to H1 15-min reset, DLQ -> human review, watchdog, concurrency cap <=4
recommendations.memory: SQLite + FTS5 + sqlite-vec embeddings; skip standalone vector DB below ~1M vectors; orchestrator persists plan before big tool dumps
recommendations.models: cheap tier for recon/hunters, strong tier for validation and orchestrator, route at parent level (subagent routing bug GitHub#43869)
recommendations.security: sandbox per agent (bubblewrap/Docker), egress allowlist proxy, credentials outside sandbox, arg-list exec never shell=True, read-only default + human gates, isolate untrusted content (OWASP LLM01)
recommendations.observability: OTel GenAI semconv, per-run token/cost, FP-rate as north-star metric
recommendations.roadmap: P0 cleanup+security -> P1 recon/agent orchestration/validation/evidence/reporting -> P2 SaaS fixes+observability+sandboxing
